reason: My wheels are fine right now and I'd rather put spare cash into the car than a set I don't need this week. £240 is okay for refurbed 17s but I can usually find a set on Marketplace for £150-200 and haggle it down.
objection: New seller with no reviews, so I can't tell if the crack check is real. Refinished wheels can still be bent or have hidden cracks, and I'd be spending money I don't have to spare.
would_change_my_mind: A set in my exact fitment for about £180 that I can check in person with a clear balancer report, or a few real reviews from local buyers.
